name: Kingdom of Kush
description: An ancient kingdom in Nubia, centered along the Nile Valley in what is now northern Sudan and southern Egypt.

name: Kingdom of Aksum
description: A trading nation in the area of northern Ethiopia and Eritrea, which existed from approximately 100–940 AD.

name: Kingdom of Ghana
description: Ancient empire located in what is now southeastern Mauritania and western Mali.

name: Great Zimbabwe
description: A medieval African city in the south-eastern hills of Zimbabwe, the capital of the Kingdom of Zimbabwe.

name: Kingdom of Kongo
description: A kingdom located in west-central Africa in present-day northern Angola and parts of the Congo.

name: Mali Empire
description: A vast empire in West Africa from c. 1235 to 1670, founded by Sundiata Keita.

name: Songhai Empire
description: A state that dominated the western Sahel/Sudan in the 15th and 16th century.

name: Colonial Era
description: Period of widespread European colonization and administration of Africa.

name: Post-Independence Era
description: Era following the wave of independence movements across the continent.

name: African Humid Period
description: A prehistoric period when the Sahara region was a fertile savanna.
